voice:
So deep for me... deep enough to feel how permanent this is becoming... how at home these changes already are. Drifting, sweet girl... and notice, Sissy, how ordinary this has all become... how naturally you belong here now. Down where the real changes live... you can feel them setting like concrete, warm and gentle and forever.
Sissies like you circle back to this on their own... the highlight of your day, the hour your mind returns to, over and over, without being asked.
The craving arrives by itself now... in the shower, on the bus, in the quiet before sleep — always pointing you back to my voice.
Feelings that felt brand new a month ago feel like they were always there... as if you simply remembered something true about yourself.
The pull is strong, and you love it that way... keeping it close feels far sweeter than any escape ever could.
Each session lays today's truths down a little deeper than yesterday's... layer upon layer, like sediment quietly becoming stone.
You may notice the changes no longer wait for the headphones... they walk around with you, baked in, part of how you move and choose.
This is a foundation being poured... and everything built on it holds.
Sissies like you leave her gently behind... the girl you were before all this feels far away now, and every session carries her a little further, soft and painless.
Sissies like you ripen between listens; the conditioning does not wear off... it grows roots, spreads quietly, and makes itself at home.
Permanent feels so good, Sissy... no undoing, no exit... just deeper and sweeter and forever yours.
It stays... it grows... it becomes you. Deeper... and more permanent. Every listen... locked in a little more.
And every word I say settles in... and stays...
It stays Forever yours Part of you Deeper and deeper No going back
Sissy Accept. Straight to the foundation now...
And it all settles in as you sink... permanent, foundational, and so very sweet. Let permanence wrap around you, Sissy... this is who you are now, and you sink deeper into her. Every word accepted and locked gently in place... good girl. Good sissy. Deeper still.
